finding: Today all responsive behavior is Tailwind stacking (grid-cols-1 -> sm/lg) + horizontal-scroll tables; no JS breakpoints, no pit-wall mobile layout. Mobile must not equal desktop stacked.

desktop_1600.layout: header strip; 2-col: (track + standings) | (driver intelligence + event feed); timeline full-width bottom; DETAILS as side drawer
desktop_1600.density: dense allowed; track + tower + driver visible together

tablet_820.layout: track full-width; standings + driver intelligence tabbed (ORDER | DRIVER); event feed collapses to latest-3 + expand; timeline full-width
tablet_820.density: one primary surface at a time; DETAILS as full overlay drawer

rules: no 720px forced-scroll tables as default (tower becomes tab, not front page)
scrubber thumb >= 44px touch target (current h-4 w-2 thumb fails this)
speed/lap-jump controls wrap without layout shift

telemetry_windows: fixed contextual panes + tabs + drawers (recommended). Rejected: freely configurable draggable modules (Bloomberg-terminal complexity, pathology P17). Workspace feels technical and dense when needed, calm by default.
